premise: Robot tries to count every star in the Milky Way; the telescope keeps finding more; Astronomer shows him they don't even twinkle, and he stops counting to look.
inspiration: The counting-sheep lullaby, turned: counting stars that never twinkle, until looking beats counting.
lesson: Some things are for looking at, not counting.
learning: On the Moon, stars don't twinkle: there is no air to make them shimmer.

en-US.title: Counting Stars
en-US.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [excited] I'm going to count every star in the sky! said {robot:enter} Robot. {robot:face happy} {robot:live} He did a little counting dance. One. Two. Three… {canvas:milkyway 16s} Then the Milky Way came out: a river of stars across the black sky. {robot:face surprised} [gasps] More! {telescope:enter} The space telescope {telescope:live} turned its golden mirror to help, and found more behind those, and more behind those. {robot:shake} {robot:face sad} Robot's counter ran out of numbers. {astronomer:enter} Astronomer sat down beside him. [softly] Look closely, she said. {astronomer:live hold} She raised her binoculars. They don't twinkle. On Earth, the air makes stars shimmer. Here there's no air, so they just… shine. {robot:face happy} Robot looked. And looked. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face sleeping} Pilot was already snoring. {telescope:sparkle} [whispers] Robot stopped counting at three thousand, one hundred and twenty-seven. After that, he just looked.

es-ES.title: Contar estrellas
es-ES.text: {canvas:nightfall 16s} [excited] ¡Voy a contar todas las estrellas del cielo! dijo {robot:enter} Robot. {robot:face happy} {robot:live} Hizo un bailecito de contar. Una. Dos. Tres… {canvas:milkyway 16s} Entonces salió la Vía Láctea: un río de estrellas cruzando el cielo negro. {robot:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Más! {telescope:enter} El telescopio espacial {telescope:live} giró su espejo dorado para ayudar, y encontró más detrás de esas, y más detrás de esas. {robot:shake} {robot:face sad} A Robot se le acabaron los números. {astronomer:enter} Astrónoma se sentó a su lado. [softly] Mira bien, dijo. {astronomer:live hold} Levantó sus prismáticos. No titilan. En la Tierra, el aire hace que las estrellas tiemblen. Aquí no hay aire, así que solo… brillan. {robot:face happy} Robot miró. Y miró. {pilot:enter} {pilot:face sleeping} Piloto ya roncaba. {telescope:sparkle} [whispers] Robot dejó de contar en tres mil ciento veintisiete. Después de eso, solo miró.
